definition.name: AI Assistant Completion Rate (Last 7 Days)
definition.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE payload->>'terminal_state' = 'completed')::float8 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100 AS value FROM ai_conversation_event WHERE event_type = 'turn.completed' AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'

definition.name: AI Assistant Handoffs (Last 7 Days)
definition.sql: SELECT COUNT(*)::float8 AS value FROM action_invocation WHERE action_id = 'bot.handoff' AND outcome = 'completed' AND initiator = 1 AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'

definition.name: AI Assistant Thumbs-Up Share (Last 7 Days)
definition.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE vote = 'up')::float8 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100 AS value FROM ai_message_feedback WHERE updated_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'

definition.name: AI Assistant Tool Calls (Last 7 Days)
definition.sql: SELECT COUNT(*)::float8 AS value FROM ai_conversation_event WHERE event_type = 'tool.call.proposed' AND NOT COALESCE((payload->>'reopened')::boolean, false) AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'

definition.name: AI Assistant Turns Started (Last 7 Days)
definition.sql: SELECT COUNT(*)::float8 AS value FROM ai_conversation_event WHERE event_type = 'turn.started' AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
